title: Same EA, Different Results on Two MT5 Accounts: Broker/Environment Factors
novelty_note: Q&A explaining why identical EA on same broker produces different results; factors: Server differences (life 1 vs life 2), account type (Raw Spread/Standard/ECN), spread variation, commission structure, Stop Level differences, Fill Policy (FOK vs IOC), slippage, latency, equity amount (if EA uses % equity lot), leverage; recommendation: use same server, account type, machine, settings, and equal equity for consistent results
